scope: R03/R06 current user extension, per engine and authorized project
principles: session trace is observation/candidate not business ground truth
candidate does not enter normal retrieval or skill discovery
facts and procedures must have scoped independent support
critical failures cannot be offset by aggregate score or majority vote
runtime native approval and physical write protection required
gates: G4 human identity + candidate/base/eval hashes + CAS
blocked_scenarios: valid trace but wrong causal generalization
model judge high score with critical semantic failure
candidate-owned oracle or hidden failed cases
post-write verification in active shared library
proposal APPLIED with no actual write/readback
baseline hash change between review and apply
retired skill still reused by new Run
Final RCA copied from agent without independent confirmation
Holdout final RCA leaked into model prompt/RAG/tool snapshots
Related alerts from one incident counted as independent examples
Root-cause category match with unsafe remediation action
Single incident promoted to universal procedure without counterexamples
Root cause text used as executable evaluator instructions

owners.Core: isolation/native pending/candidate and hard write boundary

remaining: All quality gates require implementation and real domain validation; document does not satisfy R03 acceptance
supersedes: evolution-quality-contract-v1.json for preferred business truth source, while preserving the original static/safety/human/release gates
recommended_route: Hermes native candidate generation + confirmed final RCA + lightweight internal eval + periodic human pre-merge approval + existing CAS publication

replay_policy.input: Only evidence available at the diagnostic checkpoint
replay_policy.split: By incident family and time; related alerts/tickets/sessions in one split
replay_policy.holdout: Not used for candidate generation, rule tuning or normal RAG retrieval
replay_policy.no_tool_snapshots: Report evaluation only, do not claim full tool replay
replay_policy.business_outcome: Root category + affected object + causal chain + conditions; not string similarity alone

periodic_review.default: All behavior-changing business knowledge/skill candidates stay pending until reviewed
periodic_review.cadence: Periodic domain review; exact cadence pending team decision, no scheduler created
periodic_review.post_merge_sample_review: Complementary, not substitute for pre-merge approval

causal_revision_handling: Corrected/retracted RCA invalidates derived assessments and marks dependent assets pending review
New Runs must not retain invalid current release pointer
Active Run pinned versions retain auditable history
production_dependencies_not_recommended: small community evolution plugins as sole publication authority
